PROJECTS.title: Stilo
PROJECTS.description: Wardrobe management app that suggests outfits from your own clothes. Upload what you own, tell it what you need — it assembles outfits using AI. Co-authored a research paper on AI-assisted outfit creation.
contributions: Designed the recommendation pipeline that interprets prompts, finds matching clothes, and assembles outfits.
Built the multiplatform app with a custom drag-and-drop outfit canvas.
Provisioned cloud infrastructure on Azure using OpenTofu.

PROJECTS.title: NASA Explorer
PROJECTS.description: Search engine for NASA's space biology research. Ask questions in plain English and get answers with citations to real NASA publications.
PROJECTS.context: Team of 6 • 1st Place — NASA Space Apps Challenge 2025
contributions: Built the backend — chat, history, users, and RAG orchestration with Vertex AI.
Developed frontend features: interactive knowledge graph, article favorites, and chat integration.

PROJECTS.title: Awita
PROJECTS.description: IoT water monitor built for regions with unreliable water supply. Sensors track tank levels, the dashboard shows real-time data, and ML predicts when you'll run out.
contributions: Designed the full system — Arduino firmware, Go Lambda for sensor data, API backend, and React dashboard.
Built the LSTM prediction model that forecasts water usage and warns before the tank runs dry.
